arm_conditional_mean_delta_image_equal: to arm finite-image mean minus from arm finite-image mean; arm support can differ, counts explicit
common_image_marginal_mean_delta_image_e: mean of per-image conditional-mean differences, requiring both image means finite
mean_delta_image_equal: mean of within-image same-path deltas, requiring both path endpoints finite
same_path_pairing: image, base_replicate, k; intervals use the same base_replicate at both k
note: The original marginal_mean_delta_image_equal field is retained as an alias for the common-image marginal difference.
